'''July 2001 Ithaca tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mythica, Ithaca, NY in July 2001. [[Jonathan Yost]] won it. It is known from Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2675">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-directors-view-mythica-gamesd2675/ directors-view-mythica-games], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 21 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-directors-view-mythica-gamesd2675/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' July 2001
* '''Site:''' Mythica, Ithaca, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonathan Yost]]
